Figure 1:Overview of CLBench-V.
The benchmark covers diverse multimodal contexts and tasks, including scientific papers, financial reports, long documents, maps, sports scenes, and web-style visual question answering.
We organize these tasks into a three-level capability hierarchy: context grounding, new information application, and new knowledge learning.
The hierarchy helps separate common failures in multimodal context learning, such as missed evidence, information misuse, and ignoring context-defined knowledge.
Figure 2:Capability profiles of the evaluated models. Cell color encodes the score; solid outlines mark the best model in each column and dashed outlines mark the second-best.
